# Audit Log Schema

## File location

Writes go to `.ai-baseline/audit.YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` (date-sharded) at the project root (resolved via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`). A legacy `.ai-baseline/audit.jsonl` may also exist from earlier versions and must be read for back-compat.

## Format

One JSON object per line (JSONL). Each line is a **compact** (no extra spaces) complete audit entry. The file set is append-only — never truncate, overwrite, or delete entries.

Canonical compact example:

```
{"schema_version":"1.0.0","ts":"2026-06-21T14:32:01.000Z","session_id":"a1b2c3d4-...","correlation_id":"e5f6...","parent_correlation_id":null,"app":"billing","feature":"user-auth","plugin":"dependency-auditor","agent":"manifest-parser","command":"/audit","model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","input_hash":"abc123...","output_hash":"def456...","tokens_in":120,"tokens_out":340}
```

## Authoritative Field List (15 fields)

Every audit entry MUST contain exactly these 15 fields in any order. The entry is invalid if any field is missing.

| # | Field | Type | Source |
|---|-------|------|--------|
| 1 | `schema_version` | string | Generated by writer — always `"1.0.0"` |
| 2 | `ts` | string (ISO-8601 UTC) | Generated by writer at append time |
| 3 | `session_id` | string (UUID v4) | Provided by caller |
| 4 | `correlation_id` | string (UUID v4) | Provided by caller |
| 5 | `parent_correlation_id` | string (UUID v4) or null | Provided by caller |
| 6 | `app` | string | Provided by caller |
| 7 | `feature` | string | Provided by caller |
| 8 | `plugin` | string | Provided by caller |
| 9 | `agent` | string | Provided by caller |
| 10 | `command` | string | Provided by caller |
| 11 | `model` | string | Provided by caller |
| 12 | `input_hash` | string (SHA-256 hex) | Provided by caller |
| 13 | `output_hash` | string (SHA-256 hex) | Provided by caller |
| 14 | `tokens_in` | integer | Provided by caller |
| 15 | `tokens_out` | integer | Provided by caller |

Fields 1–2 are generated by the writer (audit-trail-agent); fields 3–15 are provided by the calling agent.

## Hard gates

**NEVER log prompt content or response content — hashes only.**
**NEVER write partial entries — one complete JSON object per append.**
**NEVER modify or delete existing entries.**

## Generating session_id

At the start of each Claude Code session, `audit-trail-agent` checks for `.ai-baseline/.session`:
- If it exists and was created in the current process session: read the UUID from it.
- If it does not exist: generate a UUID v4, write it to `.ai-baseline/.session`, use it.

In practice, agents receive `session_id` as a labelled input from the orchestrating agent — they do not generate it themselves.

## Generating correlation_id

Each top-level command invocation generates a UUID v4 as `correlation_id`. Sub-agents receive the parent's `correlation_id` as their `parent_correlation_id` and generate their own `correlation_id`.
